_about: Every tuned constant the model ships, with the evidence that set it. lib/__tests__/fitted.test.ts pins the code to these values: change one only with a new holdout result in research/RESULTS.md.

LINEUP_PRIOR_GAMES.evidence: walk-forward log loss, 48,556 games / 688 league-seasons 2022-24, best of {0,1,2,4,8,16,inf}; 2025 holdout 25,225 games: 0.5915 vs shipped efficiency 0.6120, delta -0.0205 [-0.0249, -0.0165]

EFFICIENCY_PRIOR_GAMES.evidence: best of {0,4,8,16,24,48,96,inf} on 48,556 games (0.6037); display only now

FORM_PRIOR_GAMES.evidence: unused while FORM_WEIGHT is 0; not refitted

SIM.tauShare.evidence: 6x6 grid on 37,558 team-snapshots (688 league-seasons, as of weeks 3-11); train best (0.3, 0.7); 2025 holdout 19,412: delta vs (0.4, 0.85) -0.0015 [-0.0025, -0.0004]

SIM.sims.evidence: max simulation standard error sqrt(0.25/4000) = 0.79 points, under the 1-point budget

RESULTS_PRIOR_GAMES.evidence: composite next-week log loss over {2,3.6,5,10,20}, 48,548 games; 2025 holdout delta vs 10: -0.0088 [-0.0107, -0.0070]; method of moments 2.8

TALENT_SHARE.evidence: preseason only (no games to grade it on); method of moments says 0.6 in-season; left alone

ELO.evidence: display and benchmark only; holdout log loss 0.633 (results-only Elo 0.659); not refitted

clampOdds.evidence: a stored next-week probability is never 0 or 1; no holdout game came near the bounds

DEFAULT_POWER_WEIGHTS.evidence: not refitted (roster strength needs the value model at each past date)
